result.card: Adds six test vectors to script_tests.json covering the SCRIPT_VERIFY_CONST_SCRIPTCODE verification flag. Neither error code gated behind this flag, SCRIPT_ERR_SIG_FINDANDDELETE and SCRIPT_ERR_OP_CODESEPARATOR, was asserted in script interpreter unit tests. The PR adds four failure vectors covering OP_CODESEPARATOR in executed and unexecuted branches and FindAndDelete signature matching in CHECKSIG and CHECKMULTISIG, alongside two control vectors with the flag disabled.
